# aplyx

> aplyx is a local-first job-application agent. It searches job boards in one pass,
> deduplicates against your local history, checks each posting against your
> preferences with deterministic rule-based logic (not a model's guess), tailors your
> resume per posting grounded in your real resume (cover letters and application
> essays are a hosted-plan feature), and applies through a
> browser or public APIs. Every application is reviewable before it goes out, and
> the browser extension never clicks submit for you.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/). For the full
text of every page in a single request, fetch **https://aplyx.app/llms-full.txt**.

## Key facts

- **What it is:** a terminal app (TUI) and a native desktop app (Tauri), both on
  the same local-first core, for macOS, Linux, and Windows; plus a Manifest V3
  browser extension for autofilling application forms.
- **Boards searched:** Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, SmartRecruiters, and
  more, in one deduplicated pass.
- **Extension coverage:** Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workday. It detects a real
  application form, asks before acting, fills only fields it can answer honestly,
  and never submits — you click submit.
- **Pipeline:** search -> deterministic fit-gate -> per-posting resume tailoring
  (cover letters & essays on hosted plans) -> review queue -> you approve every
  send. Post-apply status tracking (rejection,
  assessment, interview, offer) is read-only, opt-in, and off by default.
- **License & cost:** free and open source (MIT) for local use. No account, no
  waitlist, no card.
- **Requirements (local):** a coding agent drives it. Full capability (including
  browser-automated applies) with opencode or Claude Code; a reduced
  API-fed-boards-only path with Codex CLI or GitHub Copilot CLI.
- **Hosted tier:** planned, not live. Search, tailoring, and auto-apply from
  aplyx's own servers with no local install or coding agent. Pricing shown on the
  site ($5 Basic / $9 Intern / $13 Pro, monthly) is illustrative and not final.
- **Install:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keshm2/aplyx/main/src/scripts/install/install.sh | bash`
  (macOS/Linux), a PowerShell one-liner on Windows, or `npm install -g @keshm/aplyx`.
  Installs to `~/aplyx` (override with `APLYX_HOME`).

## Privacy

- Running locally, your profile, resumes, and application history stay on your
  machine and are never uploaded by aplyx itself.
- A hosted account stores your profile and resume file(s) in a Supabase-backed
  cloud database, scoped to your account by row-level access rules. ATS account
  credentials are stored in Supabase Vault, encrypted at rest.
- Resume tailoring sends the relevant job description and resume text to whichever
  coding agent's model provider you use, the same as using that agent directly.
  Cover-letter and essay drafting (hosted plans) runs on aplyx's servers.
- Gender, ethnicity, and date of birth are always optional.
- Discord status updates and Google Sheets tracking sync are opt-in and off by
  default.
- Full detail: https://aplyx.app/privacy.html

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://aplyx.app/): what aplyx is and how the four-step pipeline works.
- [Features](https://aplyx.app/features.html): multi-board search, the deterministic
  fit gate, per-posting resume tailoring (cover letters and essays on hosted plans),
  the review queue, inbox status tracking, TUI and desktop parity, optional Discord updates.
- [Pricing](https://aplyx.app/pricing.html): the free local tier in full, plus
  previews of the planned hosted plans.
- [Install](https://aplyx.app/install.html): install commands per OS, the coding-agent
  requirement, what the installer writes, useful env vars, and loading the
  extension unpacked.
- [Browser extension](https://aplyx.app/extension.html): detect / ask / fill /
  you-review-and-submit, and the four supported boards.
- [Changelog](https://aplyx.app/changelog.html): release history.
- [Privacy](https://aplyx.app/privacy.html): local vs. hosted, what is stored where,
  and what goes to your model provider.
- [Terms of Service](https://aplyx.app/terms.html): rules for the software, extension,
  hosted accounts, and paid plans; automated-submission authorization; refund policy.
